description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain key extension functionality, specifically testing behavior with compound keys that include primary keys and string extensions, including edge cases and restrictions.

classes.name: KeyExtensionTests
classes.description: A test class verifying the behavior of Orleans grain key extensions, including differentiation of grains based on key components and validation of key extension constraints.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyExtensionsShouldDifferentiateGrainsUsingTheSameBasePrimaryKey
methods.description: Verifies that grains with the same base primary key but different key extensions are treated as separate instances.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyExtensionsShouldDifferentiateGrainsUsingDifferentBaseKeys
methods.description: Ensures grains with different base primary keys are distinguished, even if key extensions are the same.

methods.name: EmptyKeyExtensionsAreDisallowed
methods.description: Checks that empty string key extensions throw an ArgumentException.

methods.name: WhiteSpaceKeyExtensionsAreDisallowed
methods.description: Checks that whitespace-only key extensions throw an ArgumentException.

methods.name: NullKeyExtensionsAreDisallowed
methods.description: Checks that null key extensions throw an ArgumentNullException.

methods.name: PrimaryKeyExtensionsShouldPermitStringsLongerThan127BytesLong
methods.description: Verifies that very long string key extensions are allowed without errors.

methods.name: GetPrimaryKeyStringOnGrainReference
methods.description: Retrieves the primary key string from a grain reference for verification.
